name: InChainPepeGAN
description: A fully on-chain Pepe NFT collection whose art is generated by a neural network (GAN) running inside the contract.
about:
## About

InChainPepeGAN is a 999-piece NFT collection where every image is produced entirely on-chain. Instead of storing artwork off-chain, the contract embeds a small Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) — 3,156 parameters across three neural-network layers — and runs inference at read time to synthesize a pixel image, which it encodes as an animated GIF and an SVG wrapper directly in `tokenURI`. No IPFS, no external server: the metadata, image, and animation are all generated in the EVM.

## How it renders

Each token's ID seeds a deterministic pseudo-random draw that feeds the GAN. The network's dense and transpose-convolution layers, batch normalization, and a lookup-table sigmoid produce a small pixel grid, which the renderer packs by hand into GIF89a bytes and base64-encodes. Three related seeds are combined into a short looping animation.

## Minting

Public minting cost 0.0069 ETH and was limited to one token per wallet. The 999-token supply is now fully minted, and the owner has completed the one-time `devMint` of 100 reserved tokens. A token holder can call `changeRandomSeeds` to permanently re-roll the seed used to render their own token.

## Standards & infrastructure

Built on ERC721A for gas-efficient batch minting, with OpenZeppelin Ownable and ReentrancyGuard, and OpenSea's DefaultOperatorFilterer for royalty-enforcing transfer restrictions.

transferOwnership.warning: Hands full owner control of the contract to the new address.
